Historical full-card image of [[Sergeant Wallen (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon) (Original)|Sergeant Wallen]], matching the [[Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.

* Package: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/holotable/windows/holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe holotable-large_images_through_v17.exe] (Story #419).
* Distribution member: <code>cards/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/sergeantwallen.gif</code>.
